name: Korean Chicken Wrap
steps: Add the chicken to a baking sheet and season with salt, pepper, onion powder, ginger, gochujang, garlic, sesame seeds, honey, and soy sauce. Coat the chicken evenly. Bake in the oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes or until fully cooked.
Prepare the korean coleslaw by slicing the carrots, cucumber, and red onion into thin slices. In a small bowl, mix together the vegetables with rice vinegar, siracha and sesame seeds.
Prepare the gochujang mayo by mixing together greek yogurt, mayonnaise, milk, honey, garlic and gochujang sauce in a small bowl.
To a wrap, add the cooked chicken, korean coleslaw, and gochujang mayo. Roll the wrap tightly and serve.
